description.p: SoftphonePro is a free SIP softphone for making and receiving voice calls from your desktop. It is built on the PJSIP stack and supports SIP over UDP, TCP, TLS and WebSocket, SRTP and DTLS-SRTP, ICE/STUN/TURN, and a wide range of audio codecs including Opus.
Features include multiple accounts, call history, contacts, call recording, voice isolation, desktop notifications, and handling of sip:, tel: and callto: links.
Turning on LAN Link no longer stops the calling engine. Lighter level meters on computers without graphics acceleration.
First public release for Linux (Ubuntu, Debian and Raspberry Pi OS, 64-bit).
